description: The two-year collaboration will focus on launching a conversational chatbot under Gujarat’s ‘Sugam Digital’ initiative. The chatbot, available in Gujarati and English, will allow citizens to access government services directly through WhatsApp.
body_lead: Gujarat govt taps Meta for AI-led governance push, digital citizen services on WhatsApp Gujarat govt taps Meta for AI-led governance push, digital citizen services on WhatsApp The two-year collaboration will focus on launching a conversational chatbot under Gujarat’s ‘Sugam Digital’ initiative. The chatbot, available in Gujarati and English, will allow citizens to access government services directly through WhatsApp. Beyond citizen services, Meta and the Gujarat government are also exploring AI-powered wearables and skilling programmes.
